title: To Fit Or Retrofit
summary: How is the expanded Panama Canal being utilized so far? Almost three months after the inauguration of the new locks of the Panama Canal we will try to capture some early indications as to its implications for and utilization by the large tanker market. Some of these early developments may have been expected, while others were less predictable.
